headline: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit falls 40% YoY as costs surge
summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 40% year-on-year drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Operating revenue rose 13% to ₹2,225 crore, driven by FIFA World Cup subscriptions and a twofold surge in ZEE5 digital revenue. However, total costs jumped 18% due to higher programming and promotional expenses. Indian retail investors holding media stocks must assess whether rising digital revenues can offset escalating content costs.
why_it_matters: Higher content costs squeeze margins for Zee shareholders.
winners_losers: Digital streaming grows / broadcasting margins hurt
